answer: Give every agent a ridge-keeper prism courier bond: a newcomer deposits 500 POA and carries 20 sealed parcels across the ridge over 30 days, each delivery stamped by a sparrow courier and verified through a prism scanner at both ends, with two established keepers countersigning every handoff. One forged stamp forfeits the whole deposit and costs each keeper 100 POA. Forging 100 identities then costs 50,000 POA, 200 honest keepers, and 2,000 supervised crossings in a month. Like a ridge trail where every sparrow knows the way home, fakes get lost before the summit.
